merkle_binding.parameter_source: MerkleTreeParams::new(row_size,col_size,50); dimensions are supplied by trusted circuit/taps and committed po2, not read as attacker-controlled lengths.
merkle_binding.tree_height: L=log2(row_size), with assertion row_size is a power of two.
merkle_binding.cap_depth: top_layer=max(0,min(floor(log2(50)),L-1)); top_size=2^top_layer. In the normal recursion/FRI domain sizes this is 32 digests.
merkle_binding.root_commitment: Read cap in fixed left-to-right order; validate Poseidon digests; recompute ordered binary parents to root; commit root. Cap itself is not separately mixed.
merkle_binding.leaf_length_binding: Exactly col_size canonical field words are consumed. No leaf-length prefix is added to leaf hash.
merkle_binding.leaf_position_binding: idx<row_size; virtual index=idx+row_size. Every low bit determines left/right hash-pair order while ascending. Index is not prepended to leaf hash.
merkle_binding.tree_depth_binding: Parser uses exactly L-top_layer siblings, then compares to the derived cap index. Height is enforced by fixed parameters; no height tag is hashed into each node.
merkle_binding.encoding: Base fields are reduced Montgomery u32 representations, extension fields flatten their four components. Poseidon digest stores eight reduced Montgomery words.
merkle_binding.leaf_and_node_domains: Internal nodes use unpadded_hash(16 field elements). Leaves use the same unpadded function; there is no explicit leaf/node, index, level, width, or purpose tag.
merkle_binding.digest_validation: Cap children and supplied siblings checked through is_digest_valid; base/extension openings through ReadIOP::read_field_elem_slice<T>.

poseidon2_rng.commit: If pool_used!=0, first permute and reset pool_used=0; add 8 raw-Montgomery digest words to first 8 cells; permute once.
poseidon2_rng.squeeze: Return cells[pool_used], increment; at pool_used==16 first permute and reset.
poseidon2_rng.ext_challenge: Four sequential base squeezes; fixed Fp4 basis.
poseidon2_rng.bit_challenge: Always consume four base squeezes; choose first nonzero canonical as_u32 value if any, otherwise zero; mask to requested low bits.
poseidon2_rng.query_sampling: With replacement; all queries are fixed by RNG state after final polynomial commitment because openings do not change RNG.
poseidon2_rng.ideal_sampling_deviation: If each base squeeze is conditionally independent uniform Fp and k<=27, TV(random_bits(k),uniform k-bit)=(1-2^-k)/p^4 <=p^-4; at most 50/p^4 for 50 queries. This statement does not prove Poseidon2 has that ideal distribution against quantum queries.
poseidon2_rng.recursion_rng_permutation_count: 26+2R, excluding all hash_elem_slice/hash_pair calls and all nested verification, under this fixed call sequence; this is a source-level cost count, not a QROM-query equivalence.

grinding.evidence: Full manual control-flow read plus keyword scan in the six pinned local source files; no nonce read followed by a PoW/leading-zero/difficulty acceptance check.
grinding.limit: This does not exclude adversarial off-line transcript search, outer application gates, the separate rv32im protocol, or the generated recursion interpreter's emulated verifier. No theorem credit is assigned from the PoN lottery.

open_interface_proofs: Specify vector-commitment message type and public parameters (row count, row width, tree height, field encoding, suite, circuit, phase); show they cannot change during extraction or between alternative accepted openings.

Give the quantum extractability/collapsing/binding property actually required by the selected QROM compiler for this fixed-width cap-Merkle construction. Classical collision resistance alone is not an instantiation proof.

Relate unpadded, zero-padded-last-block Poseidon2 to the theorem's oracle model. Same-size input restriction, no node/leaf or purpose tags, and cross-length aliases must be handled by authenticated typing or a proved joint construction.

Account for the same underlying Poseidon2 permutation serving commitment hashing and stateful Fiat-Shamir RNG; prove the needed joint quantum oracle simulation/indifferentiability or explicitly state and cost an additional assumption.

Prove the exact transcript state machine, challenge order, field/bits sampler, and permitted statement adaptivity match the theorem; include the non-circuit_debug build precondition and sampler deviation.

Prove generated recursive verification implements the same transcript/encoding and soundness relation for every allowed control program; control-root membership alone does not establish this semantic equivalence.

Instantiate circuit-specific RBR/state-restoration and algebraic proximity bounds, including exceptional DEEP points, all recursion nodes and accepted circuit sizes; no generic FRI/RO theorem supplies these automatically.

Count lifetime quantum queries across all uses, proof attempts and recursive instances under the compiler's model, retaining constants/reduction losses. The observed native permutation count is not automatically an oracle-query budget.
